why: Turns the ceiling exclusive. The one build that must never fail is the one sitting exactly on a number somebody chose deliberately -- and that is also the build a ceiling gets set to when someone raises it to today`s size, so this mutation makes the gate fail immediately after every legitimate raise. The overage arithmetic in the message would also report 0 B over, which reads as a bug rather than a policy.
killedBy: bundle budget: what it refuses is an inclusive ceiling: exactly at the budget passes, one byte over fails
